title: pavonia tuberculata
intro: Pavonia tuberculata, commonly known as rockrose or rose mallow, is a flowering plant species in the mallow family. It is native to Mexico and Central America and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Pavonia tuberculata include its ability to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, fighting free radicals, and soothing skin irritations.
